notes.title: 1 MONTH LEFT TO LAUNCH...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31997051/e6e7db5f04ebc860fc8d757278cc545d4e2cc293.png[/img]

Hey there! Today is a good day to get hyped for our next tycoon game that is arriving to Steam on [b]February 10th[/b]! 

The last few weeks has been amazing, the number of wishlists has proved this sequel to be a massive success and a milestone for us even before launch. A year ago we had a "dreams" list of things we wanted to do to in this project based on what we learned from Gamer Career Tycoon. We can proudly announce that every single one of those new things are now in the game. We have put a great amount of effort into major additions to [b]the progression[/b] and [b]character choices[/b], we also added some truly cool stuff and improvements to [b]the game world[/b] and how it interacts with you. And then of course we have the new [b]isometric style graphics[/b] that we believe suits the game very well.

[h3]PREPARING FOR RELEASE[/h3]
We are currently hard at work refining and polishing to get ready for launch. We cant wait to share the game with you. Thanks again everyone for your support, following and wishlisting the game. Every bit helps out. We are very happy to see that so many of you are looking forward to the launch, we are, after all, making this game for you.

[b]Pricing[/b]
Digital download on Steam available February 10th, 2022
$9.99 with a 15% launch discount

notes.title: Football School is now released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/250aae6db17197e83dda822c88dfd5ffeb9e216d.png[/img]
[h1]Football School is now released on Steam![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087110/Football_School/

[h1]CREATE YOUR TEAM...[/h1]Pick the right combination of novice players for your starting team. There are 3 classes to choose from. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/168f1676c9ef866a2c548586a4264d8f1b2e7008.jpg[/img]

[h1]PLAYER CLASSES...[/h1]Each class has a unique special ability on the pitch that can be improved and become very powerful.

[h2]STRIKER[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/ec9bad54315412d2cea92568742cc321fe609dd5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/4de80d1fbf6a79de3ba70f8310d3db7c12ade109.png[/img][/url]
Strikers has the special ability to kick the ball so hard that everyone it hits gets knocked out.

[h2]MIDFIELDER[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/355286d08b65ba0fc3ac688417df4fcbb2e56aaf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/2d5f0ef69992bf7eedb12f578028288f25a7b80a.png[/img][/url]
Midfielders has the special ability to regenerate stamina for his teammates when handling the ball.

[h2]DEFENDER[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/6a02db32b0cb35a9f53012e4ee0dfa880bd50daf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/0b2571ec2b91b21f490db9614859400092f0f79e.png[/img][/url]
Defenders has the special ability to tackle down and knock out opponents.
		
[h1]TRAIN YOUR TEAM....[/h1]You can assign your players to training that will increase their stats and skill.  How will you choose to prepare them for competition?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/b4c51ae316afa12e09b95c490f41b57ab550a4af.jpg[/img]

[h2]KICK[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/c61cc2cddff0ead55ee7b40d3fc9fa43734f8626.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/4d8c9148e72c6a889d8538c804a08e6261a3694c.png[/img][/url]
Kick affects how hard and accurate a player can kick the ball.

[h2]SPEED[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/7b31b92ce636961c2b4ddfe638d2f5a59140ea6b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/14df932ea080e1405b260998e31cf7899860e8f8.png[/img][/url]
Speed affects how fast a player can move, react and take decisions.

[h2]STAMINA[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/75317eaff1102257994e0822ce6805d1d2ee6a8e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/d4e332e4f3ba39b28287d2770ec668cbe99ae8e3.png[/img][/url]
Stamina affects how much a player can do on the field before getting tired and must rest.

[h2]BODY[/h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/9a387751f0f2325f1136c11e829e8edc8e78dc1e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/59a295015f083980277a7179d7707018d86e4903.png[/img][/url]
Body makes the player recover faster from getting stunned by tackles or shots. Body also affects defenders tackle ability and makes it stun opponents longer.


[h1]SPECIALITY PERKS...[/h1]You will be able to choose speciality perks for your players. Any player class can choose any speciality. Every time your team plays a friendly or competitive football match they will gain experience based on their performance. For example the player with the best rating gets a player of the game bonus and will get a huge XP bonus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/d6541f16ab708e63f47bf0d69d2123a2e5a93ad4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Goalkeeper[/h3][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/72fefac0b9e47c382e99324f6f86501b4e61fa4e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/12d07fd3f9de13a99ea6463386f1c3e56e99bf2e.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Dribbler[/h3][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/6e91d978b3ed2d7a0d49639b546a366b514ef71c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/689117b742b7e4c985fa5b7abdd28129bf615691.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Shooter[/h3][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/e26e76ada4ca612ba6cbaeb276e5a0e373b0dd3f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/e8c35c0f1bef0ee993371dd9462a9c8e111e0204.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Goalscorer[/h3][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/f3a2d366ae5faebb7e85408ce9c040c73b4575d3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/01f008dc5beeed8ad306773198b193012ec9f986.png[/img][/url]

[h1]TACTICS...[/h1]
One part of your job is to coach your team. In Football School you have access to create your own custom team formation. Your players positions on the field can be key to victory. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/3d83d883d43d529c73856b39e961e926b34b627a.jpg[/img]
You can try out many ways in combination with team compositions and tactics settings.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.31.156 released!
notes.content:
Version 1.31(build=156) is mostly a refinement-and-fix overhaul.
[list]
[*] Added New Auto set recommended button for esport sliders.
[*] Changes to how esport sliders work based on character stats.
[*] Advanced Playstyle esport slider settings now only require skill.
[*] Risky Mentality esport slider settings now only require mental stats.
[*] Offensive Focus esport slider settings now only require knowledge.
[*] Added visual feedback for AI opponents strategy settings in esport.
[*] Tweaks to AI opponents and other players in team esport.
[*] Tweaks to skill, mental and knowledge stats in esport.
[*] Tweaks to Charisma, hype effects has been slightly decreased.
[*] Tweaks to Perception, skill effects has been increased.
[*] Many other tunings, redesigns and minor bugfixes.
[*] Savefiles from all previous versions are compatible.
[/list]

Thanks for writing your opinions and reporting bugs. It matters to us. Reworking major systems in a game like this takes time and there is only 2 of us so all your support is a big help!

We’re currently hard at work on our next planned content update called "House/Mansion". Good progress is being made daily. We’re looking forward to sharing this new content with you.

That’s all for now. Back to coding. Cya soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.149
notes.content:
Dear players! Thanks everyone for bug reports and your feedback, In the old builds, balance problems obviated some of the challenges in the game, we are sorry if this affected your gameplay. We carefully read every review and all discussions, gathering information about what you do and don't like in the current build of the game.

This update gives a more challenging early game. However there are still some things which could make the game abit too easy once you get enough hype with correct game combination, community trends, quality/gearscore/internet speed, charisma bonus, combined with marketing/promotion bonuses stacking up based on your followerbase and hypemeter effects during a stream. And some other bonus boosts. This will be addressed!

Here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Tweaks to the game's balance, it is now harder to gain subscribers.
[*] Tweaks to the amount of popularity/hype a stream will gain from promotion.
[*] Tweaks to AI opponents subscribers and followers gain.
[*] Tweaks to channel hype, it now provides a more direct boost to follower gain.
[*] Tweaks to all bonus effects from maximum 100% hypemeter during a stream.
[*] Fixed a crash which occured when playing esport tournament on stage.
[*] Fixed minor UI bug that could cause crashes.
[*] Many other tunings, redesigns and minor bugfixes.
[*] Savefiles from previous version are compatible
[/list]
Restart Steam to force an update to get the new version.

Thanks for your support! <3
/Raptor Claw

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.147
notes.content:
A quick hotfix to address some major bugfixes. We solved a major issue with max level in endgame forcing some players to go bankrupt. This has been fixed! Additionally, improvements were made to overall progression balance.
[list]
 [*] Tweaked organization popularity level bonus values
 [*] Tweaked maximum target audience values in endgame
 [*] Tweaked experience gain for organization
 [*] Tweaked fans gained from promotion in gaming rooms
 [*] Tweaked merchandise sales based on popularity level
 [*] Tweaked popularity bonus values for teams in gaming rooms
 [*] Tweaked popularity channel hype values for stream channel
 [*] Tweaked promotion effects for stream channel
 [*] Tweaked maximum storage capacity for organization
 [*] Tweaked charisma bonus effects
 [*] Solved various powerleveling exploits in endgame
 [*] Fixed several issues with sound effects
 [*] Fixed issues with trigger for endgame cinematic
 [*] Fixed issues with economy overview not working
 [*] Fixed several issues with crashing in loading screen
 [*] Updated several tooltips
 [*] Numerous minor bug/grammar/graphics fixes
 [*] Savefiles from previous version are compatible
[/list]
